title: Concept: Gradle verification entry without an artifact hash
description: verification-metadata.xml declares a dependency verification entry whose artifact records no checksum, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Dependency verification is on, but that entry cannot verify anything, so a substituted jar passes while the build still claims verification.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through verification-metadata.xml (gradle).
risk: Dependency verification is on, but that entry cannot verify anything, so a substituted jar passes while the build still claims verification.
